name: Onee-chan o Ninshin Saseta Otouto
original_name: お姉ちゃんを妊娠させた弟
source:
Big sister loved her little brother enough to take his virginity.
He liked it so much that they carried on,
and she got pregnant.

The story of their incest, and what happens after she gets pregnant.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ113922.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
姐姐非常爱她的弟弟，甚至夺去了他的童贞。
他非常喜欢这样，所以他们继续下去，
她怀孕了。

他们乱伦的故事，以及她怀孕后发生的事情。
